note: WO13 frozen corpus for legalityFor / legality_for (WO13_CONTRACT.md §7.3, as amended by Amendment 3 — WO13_AUDIT.md D15). Read by BOTH cargo test (src-tauri/src/lint/tests.rs) and Vitest (src/config/edgeRules.test.ts). Each case is a flat (sourceRole, kind, targetRole, targetDeprecated) input against the production function directly — no graph needed, since legalityFor/legality_for take these four values, not a BarnGraph. `expected` is `{ legality, reason }`; `reason` is checked byte-exact for every non-allow legality (allow rules always carry an empty reason). Cases 1-12 assert the Amendment 3 precondition: EVERY one of the 11 production rules that used to outrank the (now-removed) `@deprecated` table row must lose to it, plus a target matching no rule at all. Cases 13-25 assert every rule's own non-deprecated behaviour is UNCHANGED by the amendment. The tie-break rule (later entry wins on an equal specificity score) has no natural collision in this production table and is instead exercised locally, in each language's own test suite, over a small synthetic table — not part of this shared corpus (see edgeRules.test.ts's own 'later entry wins on an exact score tie' test and lint.rs's mirror). Owned by tech-lead; no lane may edit this file.
